About Jake

BBJake is the 559's #1 content creator, a Visalia streamer, YouTuber and event host who built his community by showing up. Park boxing events, car meets, a $$$ 1v1 tourney, and the biggest water balloon event the 559 has seen, with 350+ people.

He's live almost every day, and he's been featured on SportsCenter's Instagram. Between streams, he gives back with food drives and giveaways around the city.

In his latest video, he took a random homeless man on the trip of a lifetime. Watch it here.

Jake is also the CEO of BeenBlessed, a self-owned Christian clothing brand out of Visalia. Every drop has sold out.
